ModMetaData.name: Junk Food
ModMetaData.author: Oinky
ModMetaData.description:
Oinky's 93 snacks, sweets, drinks and rich meals, updated for RimWorld 1.6 and the current RimRound redesign.
Make them at a fueled or electric stove using ordinary crops, milk and chocolate. Drinks and frozen desserts can also be prepared at a brewery. Unlock the 500-point Junk Foods research; Cooking requirements range from 3 to 6. Every food lasts at least four days before rotting at normal temperatures.
Dense foods provide substantial nutrition in less stomach space. RimRound owns digestion and weight gain. Optional mild cravings and a master content switch are saved with each colony, under Options → Mod settings → Junk Food. Disabling the content stops new production and supply; existing food remains edible.
RimRound food traders carry a rotating selection. Their gifts can include treats, and occasional resource pods contain junk-food cargo. Large cola bottles, whole pizzas and KitKat piles can be opened into individual servings by selecting a colonist and right-clicking the package.
Original art and content: Oinky. Original configuration credits: Milkeshakes: Digital Deluxe Edition; Randy Burger - Fast Food set. This update uses native eating sounds and does not require Randy Burger. See CREDITS.txt for the original credit links.
Development candidate: compatibility and balance playtesting remain required. Supports the current RimRound redesign API, not the legacy upstream RimRound release.
